messages.author: 7d6ebbd01e450240
messages.subject: Combine variance-covariance matrices
parts:
Hi, not sure if this is the right place to ask this question. 

We are looking to conduct some CFAs with data from multiple sites/studies. In some cases we may not be able to access individual participant data. To get around this I was thinking we might be able to use variance-covariances matrices. 

Is possible to combine variance-covariance matrices in lavaan to examine and compare various CFA models?

Thanks!

Burt

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Combine variance-covariance matrices
parts:
If you are talking about fitting a model to each site, you can run a multigroup model on summary statistics by passing a list of matrices to sample.cov=

https://lavaan.ugent.be/tutorial/cov.html

If you are talking about treating the multiple sites as clusters, then no, those estimators require raw data.
